# Vaxo

> Vaxo (vaxogroup.com) is an app where you write what you need in your own words and the AI assistant Vax sees it through to a working result: a website with booking and payments, a CRM, an AI consultant for your customers, posts, ads, documents, presentations and calculations. For everyone — from a personal task to a company. English, Ukrainian and Russian. Free to start, no sign-up needed to try.

## Key facts
- Start in the Workspace (https://vaxogroup.com/app/): chat with Vax, memory, tools and modules on one screen. Works on phone, computer and browser; installs as an app in two taps.
- Five plans: Free $0 (all features to try, a one-page site, marked "Made with Vaxo"), Plus $19/mo (your own tasks done for you), Pro $39/mo (a one-page site or a connection to yours, AI in your site chat, every request in one app), Max $129/mo (a full site with booking and payments, AI in all messengers, posts, team with roles), Ultra $299/mo (a store or an app, social media and ads run for you).
- Everything in a plan is included, the website too. Only fully custom work (your own app, system or special integration) costs extra, and the price is fixed before work starts.
- Paying for 3, 6 or 12 months at once: 10%, 15% or 20% off. Monthly AI allowance is shown as a percentage with its refresh date.
- No trial month: the Free plan has all features. A paid plan comes with a 14-day refund, once per person. Rules: https://vaxogroup.com/refunds/
- Your accounts, site and data stay in your name; you can export your data any time.
- Partner program (18+): 50% of the client's first payment (for a month or a year) and 30% of every later payment while the client pays; money is credited 14 days after the payment. https://vaxogroup.com/partners/
- Real cases: AiPro Partners, TrichoTech.
